item.title: Nearly 60 homes impacted by massive sewage spill in Clearlake, officials say
item.description: The North Bay city of Clearlake has declared a local emergency because of a massive sewage spill. The spill has not stopped, despite efforts to repair it, because of multiple faulty valves, officials said.

item.title: 49ers pack up after blowout loss to Seahawks ended dreams of playing Super Bowl at home
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers packed up their belongings and headed home as work was being done around their home venue to get Levi's Stadium ready to host the Super Bowl next month.

item.title: Health experts warn about potentially dangerous substances Kratom and 7-OH: What to know
item.description: The California Department of Public Health is sounding the alarm on Kratom, as well as a potent derivative of the plant called 7-OH, in the wake of six recent overdose deaths in Los Angeles County. Kratom and 7-OH products are not FDA-approved and are not legal for retailers to sell.

item.title: Northern lights could be visible from across the Bay Area Monday night
item.description: Look up! Experts say the auroras - or northern lights - might be seen as far south as Northern California.

item.title: Lick Observatory repairs continue 3 weeks after devastating Christmas storm
item.description: The historic building atop Mt. Hamilton is red-tagged and closed to visitors. But Astronomer Elinor Gates gave us a first-hand look at the repairs underway.

item.title: PG&E customers still waiting on December outage payments amid more San Francisco outages this week
item.description: PG&E set aside $50 million to compensate San Francisco residents and businesses after a multi-day power outage in December. But many of those people say they have not received a single cent from the utility as another round of planned outages forces many businesses to close.

item.title: US Catholic cardinals urge Trump administration to embrace a moral compass in foreign policy
item.description: Cardinals Blase Cupich, Robert McElroy and Joseph Tobin warned that U.S. military actions in Venezuela, threats to acquire Greenland and cuts in foreign aid could cause suffering instead of promoting peace.

item.title: Indiana Hoosiers completes undefeated season, wins 1st national title, beating Miami in CFP final
item.description: College Football Playoff: Fernando Mendoza bulldozed his way into the end zone and Indiana bullied its way into the history books Monday night, toppling Miami 27-21 to put the finishing touch on a rags-to-riches story, an undefeated season and the national title.

item.title: Man attacked by group of young bicyclists in SF after he asks them to slow down
item.description: Video posted on the Citizen app outside the Maritime Museum in San Francisco shows a man being chased down by a group of young people on bicycles. The confrontation escalated with the suspects attacking the man.

item.title: Thousands march, give back to honor Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. in Bay Area
item.description: From taking the "Freedom Train" to giving back to the community, the Bay Area showed up to take in Dr. King's messages and to reflect on his lessons.
